contribution.position: I hold my earlier position. I am answering product's claim that reliability is settled because nobody else sees a problem. Other roles not raising reliability is not evidence about it. artifact:cost-sheet covers only the 3% cost against a 5% ceiling and says nothing about error rate. artifact:incident-log shows a 30-day error rate of 3.2% against a 1% SLO, with two sev2 incidents, so reliability is the axis with a measured breach. I am also answering qa's claim that risk is contained. artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) is a functional pass signal. It does not measure production error rate or show that the change avoids the failure modes behind the sev2s. artifact:perf-report (p99 within budget at peak) covers latency, not errors. artifact:ops-runbook shows rollback exists, which limits the cost of a bad outcome but does not repair the existing breach. Gap: no artifact gives the root causes of the two sev2s, maps the change to those causes, or states the remaining error-budget headroom. Those three items are needed before this axis can be called settled, and the artifact list does not contain them.
